settings.title: Settings
settings.contentFilterHint: On by default. Turn it off to hide adult titles from browse, search and your lists.
settings.shareActivityHint: On by default. Turn it off and friends can still open your profile, but not see your stats, what you are watching or your activity.

playback.title: Playback
playback.intro: When a title has several sources, the best version for you is picked automatically, in this order: your audio, then your subtitles, then quality.
playback.audioHint: If a dub in this language exists, it plays. Otherwise you get the original audio with subtitles.
playback.soft: Prefer subtitles I can turn off
playback.skipsHint: On by default. Turn it off to hide skip intro, recap and credits in the player.
playback.softHint: Chooses sources whose subtitles can be switched or hidden over ones burned into the picture.
playback.qualityHint: Handy on a slow connection or a data plan.

mal.title: MyAnimeList
mal.intro: Link your MyAnimeList account to see your list here and keep it updated as you watch.
mal.unlinkBody: Your list will stop showing here. Nothing is deleted on MyAnimeList and you can link again any time.
mal.deniedToast: You didn't allow access on MyAnimeList.

invites.title: Invites
invites.intro: Share an invite link with a friend so they can create an account.
invites.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the code and copy it by hand.

password.title: Change password
password.tooShort: The new password needs at least {count} characters.
password.mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
password.othersNote: Your other devices will be signed out.

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.intro: These devices are signed in to your account. Remove any you don't recognize.
sessions.revokeAllBody: Every device, including this one, will be signed out and will need your password again.

avatar.title: Profile picture
avatar.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB. You can crop it before saving. Without one, your linked MyAnimeList picture or your initial is shown.
avatar.cropFrame: Picture frame. Drag or use the arrow keys to move the picture, plus and minus to zoom.
avatar.cropHint: Drag the picture to position it. Everything inside the frame is kept.
avatar.cropFailed: Couldn't read that image. Try another one.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor login
twoFactor.intro: Add a code from an authenticator app to your password, so a stolen password alone can't get into your account.
twoFactor.codesLeft: {count, plural, one {# backup code left} other {# backup codes left}}
twoFactor.scanIntro: Scan this code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis…), then type the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key by hand:
twoFactor.codesIntro: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
twoFactor.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the codes and copy them by hand.
twoFactor.newCodesIntro: This replaces all your backup codes. Enter your password and a current code.
twoFactor.disableIntro: Enter your password and a current code (or a backup code) to turn this off.
